notes.title: Update 1.0.1 : Beta Phase!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/V6tcsB0.png/img]

Hello everyone!

Beta phase
This update marks the transition of Hardware Engineers entering into the Beta phase.
The most important thing to remember with this announcement is that there are still more improvements, optimizations, and contents to come.
Next week the procedure to shift Hardware Engineers in Beta phase will start.
With the Beta the update process will change.
In the EarlyAccess phase I aim was to propose new functionality as quickly as possible and to polish, balance, adapt and debug these new features according to your feedback.
Now that the core gameplay is fix, the goal will be to maintain a level of quality while adding new features. In summary larger and better but less frequent patches. 
Thank you all for all the support in this 2 and half years of Early Access!

Content
48 new computers is now unlockable.

Editors
Components Editors has been updated for the new ram format introduce in the previous patch.

Mission
Customers will now be able to choose DVDs has a secondary purchase.

Interface
It's now possible to open a mail by double clicking on it in the mailbox.
Coins and points animations has been improved.

As always many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, you can report it on discord or on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB thanks!

Thank you for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

https://media.giphy.com/media/OcZp0maz6ALok/giphy.gif

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this patch and what you would like to see in Hardware Engineers in the comment section below.

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

notes.title: Update 0.2.42
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/b5e2c339e0610b25d6bd58812bc107de8f6ffbb6.png

Hello everyone!

Beta phase upcoming
Before the patch note I would like to announce the upcoming exit of the Early Access phase!
The beta phase is coming soon. Let me know what you think and what was missing from the game right now.
Which menu, interface or window needs a redesign?
What are the weaknesses and strength of the game in your opinion? I would do my best to improve everything.
Don't worry, the end of the early access phase does not mean that the updates will stop.
It simply means that the core gameplay is now fix. New functionalities and bugfix will continue to come.

Memory Rework
You can now split and merge memory kits!
Buying a 2x16GB and merge it with another 2x16GB to obtain a 4x16GB is now possible!
https://i.imgur.com/QLlPy2P.gif

Dual Channel
You can also buy a 4x16GB and split it in 4 kit of 16GB. 
But be careful dual channel is taken into account!
Dual Channel is a technology that allow RAM module to perform in pair.
That's means a RAM module alone will perform slower than expected.
https://i.imgur.com/Bql6Lam.gif

Memory Synchronization
Like in reality, when mixing different memory module they all will run at the speed of the slower module.
https://i.imgur.com/i91VLnm.gif

Interface
Merge two RAM kit is possible in inventory by drag and drop one kit on another one of the same generation.
DDR3 and DDR4 can't be in the same kits.
You can also merge two sets of RAM directly in the assembly.
https://i.imgur.com/VjOTorQ.gif
To Split a Ram kits use the new icon in inventory

Mission
Customer's algorithm will take into account the possibility of doubling memory if they have only two RAM modules on a computer or to make a new kits by buying two set of 2 RAM modules.

As always many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, you can report it on discord or on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB thanks!

Thank you for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

https://i.imgur.com/o6mVn5c.gif

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this patch and what you would like to see in Hardware Engineers in the comment section below.

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Hello everyone! I hope you have a good holiday. 
 
Beta phase upcoming 
Before the patch note I would like to announce the upcoming exit of the Early Access phase! 
The beta phase is coming soon. Let me know what you think and what was missing from the game right now. 
Which menu, interface or window needs a redesign? 
What are the weaknesses and strength of the game in your opinion? I would do my best to improve everything. 
Don't worry, the end of the early access phase does not mean that the updates will stop. 
It simply means that the core gameplay is now fix. New functionalities and bugfix will continue to come. 
 
Preview Map 
The new map has been improved, you will have better performance and many issues has been fixed. 
https://i.imgur.com/dGFANh0.png 
 
Characters 
The 3D model and animations of characters has been improved 
https://i.imgur.com/G1mMhpN.png 
 
Engine 
It's now possible to skip the intro video. 
Steamworks library has been updated. 
Hardware Engineers will now detect automatically if your computer is missing Media Feature Pack 
 
Discord 
Feedback, help, question, idea ? Check out the new Discord ! 
https://i.imgur.com/QcDzlOP.png 
 
As always many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, you can report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB thanks! 
 
Thank you for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends! 
 
https://media.giphy.com/media/l49FqlUguNsGDNCGk/giphy.gif 
 
As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this patch and what you would like to see in Hardware Engineers in the comment section below. 
 
I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Previously Hardware Engineers used an OpenGL based engine made by myself, i finally finish to convert it to DirectX.
You will now have a more stable and powerful engine compatibilities has been improved a lot too.
Big change involve potential bugs. That's why this update will only be available on the devbranch for a few days.
I take that opportunity to make another big change: the update of Monogame to v3.7.1.189
A new game intro with a super cool logo for Green127Studio !

Music
All royalty free music has been replace by new fun soundtracks !

Interface
SuperHash will now alway show you the right balance.
The 3D models of the map has been improved for performance and aesthetic.

As always many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, you can report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB thanks!

Hello everyone!

Ink Cartridge
You will now be able to sell ink cartridge in your store.
Cartridge works loke mice and keyboard, you can buy 20 at onces in a box and expose the box directly on your showcases.
A box of 20 cartridges contains 10 black cartridges and 10 color cartridges.
Unlike the other component two different cartridges will never be equivalent. If a customer asks you for a cartridge you must provide the exact model he wants.
https://i.imgur.com/101E5oS.png

Comparison
When customers compare two items all properties is now taken into account for Screen, Keyboard and Mice.
All type of keyboard mechanics are considered equivalent except for membrane. Any mechanical keyboard will always be preferred to membrane keyboard by customers.

Content
Several new 3D models, new icons and new brands has been added.

Hello everyone!

Furniture
Furniture and showcases as been completely reworked.
You will now be able to place a lot more items in showcases.
How it works:
Drag and drop an item on a green slots to place the item in the showcase.
Slots change size dynamically depending on what you hold in hand.
A popup will appear to set its price, click outside the popup to close it or press enter.
If you want to edit the price after, left click on the item.
Right-click an item for removing it from the showcase.
Left-click on the showcases to upgrade en emptying the showcase.
Custom prices is now saved with the item, moving an item will not reset its prices.

https://i.imgur.com/MvZ8I33.gif
https://i.imgur.com/ESvVIbo.gif
Note: When you load a saved game whose version is less than 0.2.12 the contents of the showcases will be transferred in the delivery's box.

Miscellaneous
Some hitbox of components as been added or modified to be able to work with the new furniture system.
A new 3D model as been added to serial key to make them more visible in showcases.
Text field as been improved.
New tooltips as been added for slots's type when upgrading showcases

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

Hello everyone, this week: more keyboard, more models, new brand and of course bugfixs!

Content
New models, and improvements for the previous ones.
https://i.imgur.com/9S32vsl.gifhttps://i.imgur.com/Z2IaAlm.gifhttps://i.imgur.com/sN15hcC.gif
DVDs & Serials are now branded.
https://i.imgur.com/X18EWA7.png

Improved
In previous versions there was a delay when opening the title screen.
The menu was waiting for the Steam servers to respond to get the current most popular mods of the week. This time varies greatly depending on the quality of the internet connection available. For some it could become really annoying.
The request to Steam will now be on a different thread, which will avoids to wait.

During the creation of a new game or during the loading a save,
The game goes through the list of all the components and checks if all the needed components is unlocked, and removes the reference of removed objects (deleted or uninstalled mod)
It worked very well for a long time but since the item list begins to approach the 1500 components this task can be very long on the modest configuration.
That's why I decided to cut this task in several parts that will run simultaneously on all cores available on the processors.
From my test the duration of this task has been divided by 5 on average!

Minor UI improvements and correction has been made.
Frequency of Sad walk has been reduce.

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone!

First, I would like to remind everyone that the Hardware Engineers's Wiki is available.
Any contribution are welcome !

I have planned several changes for Hardware Engineers.

Setting up a folder tree
Currently the hard drive does not really stores files, but only certain properties like installed software etc.
The space used and the customer data are simulated by a calculation.
I would like to push the realism by adding a real folder tree that will actually contain the files and folders necessary for the gameplay.
This will open up a lot of possibilities and improve realism as well as the game's behavior towards hard drives and data.

Registry for WinDOOR
Like the hard drives WinDOOR is simulated without being really present on the hard drives.
I would like to change this by adding a registry to WinDOOR, which will allows the operating system to store data and parameters.

Update MonoGame to v3.6
The game engine uses the framework MonoGame v3.5.1.1679, a new version is available.
With a lot of changes and improvements, such as better stability, improved performance and tons of bugfix.


All these changes are now ready!
These changes are quite heavy, they need a lots of test and modification in the code, I don't want to broke the game with tons of bug and make it completely unplayable.
Which is why I decided not to include all of them at the same time, and add them step by step.

Engine
The migration to the new version is complete. There are many things that have had to be corrected especially for shaders and the management of VSync,
if you encounter any bug. Do not hesitate to create a topic on the community hub via Steam: Bug Report section
If you are a Modder who use content builder, all your mod need to be updated with the new version of MonoGame.
First, uninstall MonoGame SDK 3.5.1, Then follow first few steps of the guide ([HowTo] Use Models Builder) about installation (all links has been updated)
When you have MG 3.6 installed you will be able to update your assets with the content builder likes before.
Sentry's SharpRaven(the reporting tool) has been updated to v2.3.2

Folders !
The implementation is not completely finalize, it is not possible to create or rename folders yet,
but we can already explore the contents of hard drives and find our downloads and others files.
https://i.imgur.com/GFidCo2.gif

Interface
The game customization window will now remember your changes for future party.
When quitting skill tree without applying change you will now have a prompt who will ask you if you want to save the changes.

And ofcourse many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

https://i.imgur.com/25MH2LF.gif

Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Hello everyone! 
 
Cables 
The new algorithm for cables is finally ready! 
Before this patch, cables's models was integrated to the components. They were immovable and impossible to change in the game. 
Now they will be generated dynamically during the game. 
For the moment the new algorithm will not change much for the player except for the computer's esthetics, but it will allow me to add new features much easier in the future. 
Hard drives and optical drives will now also have power cables. 
https://media.giphy.com/media/uktleNc4eOCOYJjETH/giphy.gif 
 
Content 
Several CPU cooler with new 3D models and optical drives has been added. 
Other small improvement has been made to Coolers (see summary list bellow) 
https://media.giphy.com/media/11R9j66tRntoA0252W/giphy.gif 
 
Notification 
The notification system has been improve to prevent the player to be spamed with too many identical message, in case of repeated click. 
 
Performance 
Performance during translation and text writing has been improved. 
 
Explorer 
winDOOR. can run its own programs but some time bug happens... in this case you will get a winDOOR's blue screen instead of a game crash. 
 
And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important! 
 
As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below. 
 
Here is a real footage of the new algorithm that trains to make nice curves:
https://media.giphy.com/media/2ZXucmnxNHNwWCulUV/giphy.gif 
 
Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends! 
 
I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Adding new cables system

Adding new Optical drives

Improved Performance
Improved Explorer
Fixed Cooler sold with wrong fan brands
Fixed Cooler sold without fans
Fixed Mailbox close itself when deleting message
Fixed Cache flushing to often
Fixed assembly's mask
Fixed slowdown in assembly
Fixed potential useless resetting of graphics settings
Fixed 1 memory leak introduce in 0.1.90

notes.content:

Hello everyone!

Animations
As in the previous patch, more high quality animations have been added!
https://media.giphy.com/media/9JjVcIqfpLgOZ7Kq2A/source.gif

Interface
A new interface for tutorials and mission proposals has been implemented with animated models and better readability of objectives!
The build mission requirements are now sorted and displayed by group.
https://media.giphy.com/media/9uIJuhEGydduk7bqlA/source.gif

A search bar has been added in the network interface and the downloads folder for easier navigation in the explorer
https://media.giphy.com/media/2zcrKlwpvkF3yGJdTa/source.gif

https://media.giphy.com/media/2ysRNfE5JHJKrLLZnZ/source.gif

Path
Cars and walkers will now move more smoothly

Balancing
The mission reward in reputation and experience has been slightly modified to best reflect the difficulty of the mission.
The performance of Optical Drives have been rebalanced.

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

notes.title: Update 0.1.88
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone!

This week a I worked on the game's artworks. Some of you have already noticed the graphics charter change on the shop page and on steam in general.
Everything has been updated to match the new version of the game.
I also have the pleasure to announce you that a demo version of Hardware Engineers is being validated by Steam. It should be available in the next days!
It took me a lot of time, and I could not worked much on the game itself. but I still have many things for you!

Demo
https://media.giphy.com/media/w9d1KGOGYavq7Jd3fG/source.gif
I think a demo version can be a good way to increase the popularity of a game and make it discovered by more people without revealing too much!
The demo limitation will be:
 limited number of components, decorations and furniture(~30% of the content available).
 Only five mods subscription at a time
 Level max at four instead of ten
 Rules customization limited to easy mode
 Overclocking, benchmark score, steam achievements and editors disabled


Improvement
Blank DVD will now appears in shop's equipment section
When mouse over a computer under the desk you can now hold CTRL to get the full tooltips.
https://media.giphy.com/media/5PhDW9T9uMXPrQiSyw/source.gif

Balancing
Build mission will have less performance requirement in general.
The Upgrade mission(purple) and Build mission(pink) amount has been slightly reduce. In return Buy mission(white) and Order mission(blue) has been increased.
Showcases effectiveness has been increased

Translation
A new quick guide about how to become a translator is now available: [HowTo] Become a translator of Hardware Engineers

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

https://media.giphy.com/media/1eExO2C5cZvNtDxQa2/giphy.gif

Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

notes.title: Update 0.1.87
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png  
  
Hello everyone!  
   
Mission 
New type of mission!  
Customers will now be able to ask for a complete computer with certain budget and exigencies. 
Customers will choose a combination of prerequisites among the 22 new to create unique mission scenario. 
https://i.imgur.com/kQUa8ZH.png 
 
Offline Mode 
Offline mode is now supported ! From now you should be able to play Hardware Engineers in offline mode at any time! 
If Hardware Engineers is already installed on your computer, makes sure to start it at least one time in online mode to enable the offline mode. 
For a fresh installation the offline mode will be enabled automatically. 
https://i.imgur.com/tZdWfnQ.png 
 
Modding 
New requirements about consumption has been added to modded components. 
To improve the gaming experience with mod created by the community certain rules have been added to the editor and the loading process. 
It will no longer be possible to upload a mod that does not respect these standards. 
Mods already available that do not meet these standards will be ignored when loading. 
The new rules 
 PSU must be at least 100W. 
 NAS must be at least 20W. 
 Every components with no power consumption will be ignored (except for case, disk, vrd, blueprint) 
 
 
If you are not sure that your mod meets all the standards, I recommend you to update them by following this guide:[HowTo] Update your mods  
 
Interface 
Some windows related to the new mission type has been slightly improved

Trailer 
New trailer for the shop!
https://youtu.be/O6QCCfQqjHE
 
And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!   
   
As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.   
   
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwG6De4UmrddOA0g/giphy.gif   
   
Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!   
   
I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Adding mission build !
Adding offline mode !
Adding 22 missions requirement type
Adding more mod requirements (consumption)
Improved mission window
Improved Security
Updated Steamworks (2/2)
Fixed bug with modded item's drivers
Fixed Translation
Fixed OS not detected when apply serial 
Fixed bug while loading old saves
Fixed bug while drawing item
  
https://i.imgur.com/VVWLlaf.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/CUIrgaj.png

https://media.giphy.com/media/l4pSXQjDERnouuCxW/giphy.gif 
 
Mission 
The window that's used for complete a mission has been reworked. 
From now only the bad checks will be showed. 
When canceling a repair mission, the customers will give you back the components that it does not belong to them. 
https://media.giphy.com/media/26DN4gtyvvgOtg0ms/source.gif 
 
Modding 
Steamworks libraries and codes has been updated to match the new Steam'SDK. 
Modded components have now requirements. 
The rules: 
Processor need at least one cooling slot 
Motherboard need at least one processor, graphics card and Memory slot 
Case need at least one motherboard, power supply and Hard drive slot 
NAS need at least one Hard Drive slot 
It will no longer possible to upload components that does not respect these rules. 
Every mod already online that break these rules will be ignored during loading. 
I recommended to every modder to update their mods frequently! 
A quick guide : [HowTo] Update your mods 
 
And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

notes.title: Update 0.1.83
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone, this week Bios, Overclocking, Stability test and a lots of fix!

BIOS
You can now access the BIOS from the boot selection menu.
https://i.imgur.com/VPwt5Ce.png
In the BIOS you will be able to change several settings of your motherboard.

Overclocking
Overclocking is now possible in Hardware Engineers!
https://i.imgur.com/a2ouVq9.png

How it works?
Each motherboard have a base clock (sometime named "BCLK").
Each processor have a Clock Ratio.
For example if you motherboard have a BCLK of 100Mhz and your CPU a ratio of 30 that means your CPU will run at 30*100=3000Mhz
Some CPU is overclockable, if so, their ratios will be unlocked.
You can change this ratio to increase their frequency.
BUT, the more you increase the frequency the less your computer will be stable.
To enhance stability you need to increase the VCORE.
The VCORE is the voltage applied to your processor.
More VCORE means more stability but a lot more heat too, That is where TJunctionMax is important!

What is TJunction Max ?
TJunction Max is the maximum safe temperature recommended not to reach by the CPU manufacturer.
For operational convenience this value is showed in the BIOS.
If the motherboard measure the CPU temperatures exceed this value, it will shutdown your computer in emergency to prevent any damage.
So do not forget to use a proper cooling system.

After changing values in your BIOS you need to test the stability of your system.

If the computer doesn't boot at all that means the CPU cannot initialize itself with the settings you have made.
You need to reset the BIOS, to do this: go in assembly mode and use the new button "Reset BIOS"

If your computer can boot but crash with a blue screen when loading WinDOOR or during the execution of a task, that means the computer aren't stable.
You need to increase VCORE or decrease CPU ratio.

To be sure your computer is rock stable You will need the new software "OverClocking Stability Tools" (sometime named "OCST")

Note: Temperature influencing the stability

OCST
OverClocking Stability Tools is a software that will run lots of calculation on the computer to be sure it stay stable even with huge CPU load.
If he detects errors it will stop itself.
https://media.giphy.com/media/3osBLfNJGFmraIs2iY/source.gif
Red square+"error detected: core#" means your overclock is not stable.
Green square+"Passed!" means your overclock is stable!

Improvement
Boot sequence has been change. When powering up a computer it will always boot on the first bootable devices.
To access the boot selection, use the second button under the screen.
https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs7LChw8uHKNRaLe/giphy.gif
Search bar has been added to USB exploration and DownloadCenter>Tools.
Certain memory kits's values has been rebalancing.

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

Be careful with overclock!
https://media.giphy.com/media/g79am6uuZJKSc/giphy.gif

Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone!

Inspection
Simulation mode is now available for inspection!
In Simulation the classic inspection tool will not work anymore.

A quick guide to how to inspect component without it:
Processor: Beep code (see POST section below)
Mother Board: Beep code (see POST section below)
Power Supply: Beep code (see POST section below)
Memory: boot on a USB with RamTest87+
Graphics Card: Software "3DBench" > "Stability Test"
Hard disk drive: Software "Polygon backup" > "Scan"
CPU cooler: unbreakable if the cooler has no fan
Case: unbreakable
Optical drive: unbreakable

Other tips:
You can look at the fans rotation. If all fans rotate irregularly that means the PSU is broken.
If one fan rotate irregular, the fan might be broken or the component where the fan is mounted on.
Look at temperature, if a graphics cards or a HDD stay cold that means it's probably broken.
If a CPU get hot there are potentially something wrong with its cooler.

POST and beep code
Every current motherboards have power-on self-test (POST), So I add them to Hardware Engineers.
Now when booting up a computer a quick test will be made.
If the boot cannot success you will have a beep code sequence.
Some new beep codes as been added and more will come!
Example :
Processor: 4 long beeps
Mother Board: 1 short beep
Power Supply: 3 short beeps
Memory: 1 long 2 short beeps

https://media.giphy.com/media/l2QE69qu0yS7Udqg0/source.gif

Engine
Keyboard entry as been reworked!
You should now be able to use every characters of your keyboard evens if you have a non supported keyboard layout.
Note: For language with huge amount of glyph (Chinese, Japanese) only the glyph included in the translation mod will be available.
Note2: If you found a specific character of your keyboards not included in the game you can report it on the Steam HUB.
https://i.imgur.com/RRfwz7L.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/BpJjZiI.png

Mission
The penalties in case of unfulfilled optional objective when returning a mission and their tooltips as been reworked.
https://i.imgur.com/nA0xaeE.png
If you have both of this unchecked the penalties will be auditioned like this:-50% Money-150% Reputation-90% Experience
Yes that means you will lose a lots of reputation points if you don't do both of this objective at the same time.

Interface
Skill points to spend:
https://i.imgur.com/vitYSZz.png
Workshop tooltips:
https://i.imgur.com/U1LHxVM.png
Mods Manager:
The color of the little dot before the name of the mod show you if the mod respect the gameplay.
https://i.imgur.com/K2jRKDF.png
Speeding time will now be two time faster
https://media.giphy.com/media/l2QEgO8ImRrFiu6aI/giphy.gif

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

https://media.giphy.com/media/l2QE3FvaC1DDAk288/source.gif

Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Unlimited Money
Unlimited Reputation points
Everything is unlocked

https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7aCSEfUFmhsk95G8/giphy.gif

When changing value the trackbar will now slide smoothly to the new value instead of "jumping" to it.
Trackbar will no be easier to grab.
If you click nears the slider. The slider will now jump to the mouse cursor to compensate automatically your potential lack of precision. I called this feature the "snap zone" because it sound cool nah?

Performance
As the previous patch I continue to work on performance improvement and code cleaning!
This time, performance for light rendering as been improved.

And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png    
    
Hello everyone this week a lot of new contents!    
    
Inventory    
Send items directly from your inventory to the bin can now be done with the old sell button    
http://i.imgur.com/Wj2dbd1.png    
    
Content    
This time most of the work has been dedicated to make new content and balance them.    
Not less than 90 new processors, 200 memory, 120 hard disk 269 graphics card and 6 optical drive.    
The total number of components has been increase from 221 to 794!    
    
As you can imagine, balancing all that was a complex job, if you found something strange , do not hesitate to make a feedback!    
The old ram, HDD, CPU and GPU has been remove.    
    
And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!    
    
As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.    
    
https://media.giphy.com/media/l4CCWPVzccS04scJa/giphy.gif    
    
Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!    
    
I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!    
    
Summary:    
Adding sell icon in inventory     
Adding 3 new brands     
Adding 90 new CPU     
Adding 200 new rams     
Adding 120 new hard disk     
Adding 269 new graphic card     
Adding 6 new optical drive     
Removing old RAM, HDD, CPU and GPU    
Fixed wrong text size in shop

notes.title: Update 0.1.64
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone!

Interface
Two new windows has been integrated to the new UI introduce in the previous patch
Skill tree: with new set of icons !
http://i.imgur.com/oW7MVAj.png
Mail box: with the new feature "Mark all as seen"
http://i.imgur.com/o2d1dA0.png

Software
http://i.imgur.com/rM28k7R.png
A new software "Vesuvius Disk Burner" will allow you to burn everything you want on disk
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGGAcqoYZR9TWGgU/source.gif

WinDOORTool have now a refresh button in the device selection phase

Mod Manager
I have added a "gameplay score" in item's tooltips.
http://i.imgur.com/1CUs18H.png
A score close to or above 80% means the mod is certainly gameplay friendly.
A score lower than 30% means the game found something strange compare to other items.
( Example: a processor with 99 core will have a very bad score, probably 0% )

This will help peoples who want to remove mod that break the gameplay.
A bad score do not always mean the mod is bad, check it first before unsubscribe a mod.

If you are a modder and your mod have a bad score, if you think the score isn't legitimate, contact me with the name or the ID of the mod.
I will try to improve the scoring algorithm accordingly

Item's tooltip
The price of a component will now be masked until you inspect it.
That will prevents player to know which hard drive is burned just by looking and compare their price.
http://i.imgur.com/D97WGuS.png


And of course many bugs was fixed. If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB this is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzgQ4zp4nRD02wYE/giphy.gif

Thanks for reading! If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Summary:
Rework skill's icon
Rework skill tree UI
Rework mailbox UI
Adding mailbox : "Mark all as seen"
Adding Software Vesuvius Disk Burner
Adding Refresh button to WinDOORTool
Adding Gameplay score in mod manager
Improving item's tooltips
Fixing Holes in map's 3D
Fixing duplicating item with right click
Fixing undetectable device on network
Fixing Serial price not counted
Fixing boot device not set when loading
Fixing translation error in date
Fixing problem with 3D in assembly
Fixing error when saving busy computer

notes.title: Update 0.1.62
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone!

USB
New functionality for USB.
You will now be able to renaming your USB key and copy downloaded software on them.
http://i.imgur.com/DDOzJIX.png

Memory
Rebalancing of all memory price and performance.
3 new memory has been added.
http://i.imgur.com/wkURPwD.png

Interface
Explorer>Computer screen:
https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7budOUy0cswWyYDe/source.gif
Inventory:
Searching by customers name
http://i.imgur.com/GQXBFbH.png

Skill Improvement
Automatism:
Selling a computer identical to a supplier's computer, will add a new computer to cart instead of the list of components. 
Selling custom computer with a serial, will add the WinDOOR serial to cart too. 
Selling a computer with a stock CPU cooler, will ignore the stock CPU cooler (already sold with the CPU)

Computer's values
More things will be take in account for the evaluation of the different value of computers.
Virus, errors, drivers, software, serial will be now take in account in the price.
Additional hard disk drive will be take in account in the "Work" score
Anti-Virus will slightly increase "Office application score".


And of course many bugs was fixed, If you found a bug, do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB is very important!

As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.

https://media.giphy.com/media/yCAoGdVUCW5LW/giphy.gif

Thanks for reading If you want to support Hardware Engineers share it with your friends!

I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!

Boot window and boot sequence
The boot window has been improved by adding slot for disk and USB drive.
http://i.imgur.com/APRap3o.png
When multiple bootable drives are connected to a computer (internally or not) a boot selection menu will automatically appears when you start the computer.

Thing to know:
This DVD are bootable
You can use this DVD indefinitely
The DVD do not contain a serial
You can make a USB Key bootable with a software


Software
One new software is available in the download center "WinDOOR. USB/DVD Tools"
This software will help you to create bootable devices for installing different winDOOR version on computer.
How to make a bootable devices:
Connect a USB key to a working computer
Download "WinDOOR. USB/DVD Tools" with this computer
Start "WinDOOR. USB/DVD Tools" and follow the instructions
Wait until the task finish
Connect the new bootable USB key to another computer
Start and boot on the USB key.
???
Profit.

Two new translations are now available on the workshop. Thank to ST4ND3Xx and Doğukan Yilmaz.

https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7btOyJi6cPfyCMCY/giphy.gif

Some of you had point the fact that this mission was sometime too difficult because the costumer's computer was already too powerful
So, the upgrade mission generation has been slightly modified to decrease the amount of very high-end computer in this mission.

I noticed many new players are a little confused at particular moment when they discover the basics of Hardware Engineers.
I try to fulfill this gape with more indications.

Hello everyone!

Time Management

Three different speeds are now available you can use the key [1], [2] and [3] to switch among them ([&], [é], and ["] on AZERTY keyboard).
You will now be able to pause the game just by hitting [SPACE].

3 new CPU coolers

Rebalancing of price and performance for all coolers

Power Supply

For modder you can change the cable texture on the channel 82 of any PSU)
https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7btSGQojXp4bAO9W/giphy.gif

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone, this week I have worked on 0.1.49 but also on 0.1.48b, c and d. I will describe all the major changes here.


Software
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGct9Y15yBCw2ae4/source.gif
A new software has been added manage hard disk drives "Polygon Backup". with this software you can Format/Copy/Clone/Inspect/Repair.

Polygon Backup can be found on the download center in categories Tools.

It does not need to be installed, you can start it directly after the download.

The option:
Format: Erase a disk.
Copy: Copy customer's file and download.
Clone: make a perfect copy of a disk
Inspect: Check the sanity of a disk
Repair: Try to repair corrupted files.


Be careful with the copy option, do not mix different customer's data, they will not appreciate that.

Also, Make sure only one copy of their files are on the computer.

However you can put all data of the same customer on one drive.

For example if a customer have two drive C: and D: you can copy D: on C: and replace D: without the need to copy back the file.

Explorer
To improve the realism and practicality the game software architecture has been rework.

Software
https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGct9Y15yBCw2ae4/source.gif
A new software has been added manage hard disk drives "Polygon Backup". with this software you can Format/Copy/Clone/Inspect/Repair.

Polygon Backup can be found on the download center in categories Tools.

It does not need to be installed, you can start it directly after the download.

The option:
Format: Erase a disk.
Copy: Copy customer's file and download.
Clone: make a perfect copy of a disk
Inspect: Check the sanity of a disk
Repair: Try to repair corrupted files.


Be careful with the copy option, do not mix different customer's data, they will not appreciate that.

Also, Make sure only one copy of their files are on the computer.

However you can put all data of the same customer on one drive.

For example if a customer have two drive C: and D: you can copy D: on C: and replace D: without the need to copy back the file.

Explorer

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png

Hello everyone! Today a lot of improvement!

3D models
More models has been enhanced for the new engine, coordinate and scale has been corrected.

Preview:
http://i.giphy.com/3o6YfTJKsEfy0ajDP2.gifhttp://i.giphy.com/3o6YfZy0iYOqEw3WUw.gifhttp://i.giphy.com/3o6YgghhGt27rLIKT6.gif

Assembly hitbox
Until now all slot use 2D rectangular to interact with components.
Now it was no longer necessary to set a 2D coordinate.
The empty slot was replace automatically by a 3D bounding box.
I plan to make the camera movable during assembling that why I need 3D hitbox to interact with components.

http://i.giphy.com/3o6YgdA8YnlxJHg76w.gif

I also make a new way to create slot directly in 3D models.

It will be a lot easier for modder to create new 3D models.

I need to update the steam guide.

http://i.imgur.com/UOBZKAf.png

Shader
Translucence materials and semi-transparent texture are now supported.

http://i.giphy.com/3o6YgaMFx9WBtIm1Co.gifhttp://i.imgur.com/Lp1Rjxr.png

Performance, Memory usage, Loading
From now, all little assets are packed in "bank files" to improve greatly loading time and memory consumption.
New loading procedure has been integrate especially for file banks.
I measure a loading performance gain by 55% on my own computer with those particular files.

In theory in-game performance will also be better due to this change.
http://i.imgur.com/zzJjAc2.png

Reporting

Hello everyone, another new patch with tones of feature!

This time a whole new facet of gameplay has been added... Explorer, Drivers, Software, Download, BlueScreen!

Explorer:
You can now click somewhere inside the computer's screen when you are on winDOOR to make the explorer appear.

To be sure your computer had all the needed driver you can go in "Computer>Settings>Devices" if you notice some "Unknown" in the devices list that means you need a driver for it.

You can found a list of all installed software and drivers in "Program", in this window you can uninstall driver if you want.

Be careful if you give a computer without all the needed driver the customer will not be satisfied and you will earn only a part of the reward.

Tooltip info:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/2e1ade05f00b0cd764cd25e764c04676dee0f97f.png

The intermediary window, that ask you for a name has been replace by a textbox directly in the assembly and the "disassemble" button has been change and move under the blueprint button.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/4a7fa682df2bbb02120ccd8dd93d9bfa87756d37.png

Patch Note : 0.1.36

Hello everyone, do you want new feature ? here we go!

Features
In the 0.1.36 you are able to save your favorite computer and buy it as much as you want. how ? with blueprint!
You will see next to the case a new blue icon in assembly.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/2695f93e64bb1eb88513831edfd6e8da6ad175b5.png

By clicking on it you will be able to save the current computer as blueprint.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/30bfada6000f4113da685f7f5d5e16e3ee66b87c.png


Then in shop you will see a new category named "Blueprint" by adding a blueprint into your cart you will add all component of that blueprint at once.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/f65edae6eb66b0ad3cb7626c8fc3159bb2997ba6.png
Note: you can saved incomplete computer if you want only certain components and change the other.

Blueprint are not saved with your game that means you can save a blueprint in one game and load it in another one.
All blueprint are synchronized with steam cloud, exactly like your saved game.
And ofcourse you can share them with steam workshop ! To be able to do that you need to go in main menu and workshop.
You will see a new button to manage your installed blueprint.

Tutorial

Patch Note : 0.1.32

Hello everyone in today patch new content, new features and bugfix!

New difficulty mode: 
First try for Medium difficulty and his compatibility system, from now you can start a game and select Medium difficulty (work in progress).
Currently in this mod only motherboard have restrictions about processor(Entil/Amp) and memory (DDR3/DDR4).
The rent for easy mode is reduce by 50%. In medium difficulty the rent still the same
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/9ec083488b1fed6f8874034d3977300e65e64d9b.png

Virus and Scan:
New type of mission added with text. When you think somebody have an infected computer you can start a scan on his hardware.
To do this you need to bootup his computer, once on desktop open the cd drive and select "Antivirus scan".
You will get a notification in lower-left corner of the screen with the result of the scan.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/5686065dd3748ac4f35bed786ef5bc88da65a264.png

Settings menu:
The Settings's UI has been reworked to separate all setting in tree category (GAME / VIDEO / SOUND).
Like this it will be more clear like this.
One setting has been added to change outline thickness
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/f194fd27ace87d711db817e54034623d48a6063d.png

New Skill Automatism:
Automatically adds to cart items sold via your showcases.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/52d26ab88ad516fc1b6c4797e5b555a1004d4fb1.png

Satisfaction calculation:
To complete the 0.1.30 patch I continue to improve the Satisfaction calculation, and fix some bug with it.

Assembly:
You will saw a new gauge instead of Gaming3D and Work gauge.
The new one its a combination of this two.
This change was made to avoid misunderstanding with the real value of the computer performance visible in tooltip
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/421a4def458a060cd85dfebd857967600d1186de.png

Update Savegame:
In load screen when you have a little orange icon on your savegame you can click on it to convert this save in the new version of the game.
If You load it directly the conversion will be done automatically but not saved until you make a new savegame.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/9de2ccf04c94ec75c9b30fef3798820ac332f639.png

Steam Cloud:
Your saved game are synchronized with your steam account, you can now repair computer everywhere you want!

Workshop editor:
All mod will be publish by default in Public mode, for those who want to create mod only for them, you can check the new checkbox "Private Mode"

Multi core usage:
Improve load time and reduce the chance of being stuck in background process if the game crash.

Crash support:
From now when you experiment a crash. By restarting the game a report will automatically be send to me. ( no personal information are send )
List of potential information send:

 The crash error code
 Mods installed
 Information about graphic card
 Your steam ID (if I need to recontact you)

This report will be used only for debugging this game all this information CAN'T be used for another purpose (see EULA for more information).

And of course many bug was fixed, If you found a bugs do not forget to report it on the Bug Report section of the Steam HUB is very important! 
 
As usual feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below. 
 
I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!
 
Summary: 
Adding Medium difficulty (WIP)
Adding Compatibility among components (WIP)
Adding Virus & Scan
Adding Outline Thickness Setting
Adding Skill (+1)
Adding Update saved game without the need of load and resave
Adding Steam Cloud
Improve Workshop editor
Improve Rent
Improve Settings menu
Improve multicore usage
Improve crash support
Improve satisfaction calculation
Change gauge in assembly
Change default computer's component to match new restriction.
Remove command "-savelog" (enable by default)
Fixed wrong duration of task with computer
Fixed wrong value in satisfaction calculation
Fixed showcase slot
Fixed Graphical error
Fixed Crash in Settings

Patch Note : 0.1.28
 
Hello everyone in today patch new content, new features and another rework of UI. 
 
The most important change is the Supplier shop, from now you have to wait a delivery time before obtain your order. To make it convenient I add a cart that you can use likes a real online shop. 
 
With this, come two new model (delivery man, and cardboard box), four new sound effect and one new skill named "Rush" to reduce delivery time. 
 
I read many of you think days duration are too long, for rebalancing this I reduce the work time from 06:00->20:00 to 08:00->19:00. 
 
In the same logic I reduce skill point per level from 4 to 3.
That means when you reach level 10 you will have 30 skill points. 
 
To complete the previous patch I add more option for modders. 
You will now able to activate "Verbose log" when you build asset. 
Like this if the build fail, you will see the reason in background.

Feel free to let me know what you think about this change in the comment section below.  
  
I hope you will enjoy this patch and see you for the next one!
 
Summary: 
Adding Delivery
Adding Models (+2)
Adding sound effect (+4)
Adding skill (+1)
Reduce day duration -3 hours
Reduce skill point per level from 4 to 3.
Adding more option for editor
Fixed crash when validating computer

Patch Note : 0.1.24
 
Hello everyone, 1.24 is now live! 
 
Scanning, copy, format a hard disk drive are now available ! to do this I add a new "equipment" categories in the shop you will found in it special part like NAS server (Network Attached Storage).

Moreover, I try to work on content and I add statistic ! from now five stat are logged and with this stat came 8 new steam achievements.

notes.title: What next?
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25938445/84e662d549e535d614ff9c6ac6a58895f43b45de.png
Hello everyone!

I heard some people were confused by not knowing what will happen now and how the game will evolved in the future.
If you are in this case I write this news especially for you!
(Warnning: all thing there can be change, replace or removed that not definitive and not exhaustive)

First I saw a lot of suggestion on the hub, I read all of them and that is really interesting thank you for your awesome idea!

In short term I will work to extend workshop possibilities (custom 3d models / custom computer / ect) for that I need to rework the component's infrastructure that can hugely impact savegame and item already on workshop.
This part of the work as practically done, but I need more conversion test with save game and workshop item.
After that I will add the possibilities to customize slots and later 3d models importer with tutorial (that will need huge amount of work).

All I can say about the longer term is I planned to work on store customization and upgrade (and with workshop item), improve tutorial, add objective (for example: do 20 missions to unlock special item or something like that), add software debugging, improve UI and add content in general (more items/models/mission/achievement/sound effect/music/state).

That is not a lot of information so far, but that already a huge amount of work to do, I will try to post regularly some news to keep you update with the development.

Thank you for reading and be interested in my work, see ya!

notes.title: Update 0.1.20
notes.content:
Patch Note : 0.1.20 
Hello everyone, in the patch of today I have many things for you.

First, skill are now enabled! The first seven skills in the tree can actually be earned by the player's character and it will affect the gameplay according to their descriptions.

As you have requested I had a doorbell sound effect when a customer comes in the shop.

I see many people can be surprised by the rent tax, I add warning message 48h before the tax and also reduce them from 2000$ to 1800$.

Marketing tab on the Management window (orange) is now filled with bank loan service. 3 Loan will be proposed to the player each day.

Some of them are daily payment some other are weekly.

To try to balance the difficulty a remove the  shortcut on Space bar, instead of it I put a slowdown and to compensate that I reduce the spawn frequency of customers. The only way to pause the game is to enter in the main menu with escape key. I let the play/stop button enabled for the moment, but maybe I will remove it later if you think is better like that.

The ratio of yellow mission/blue mission has been change from 50% to 60% in favor of blue mission. (the white and blue mission is practically the same, the difference between them depend if you have or note the item in a showcase)

Small graphical bug has been removed.

Feel free to let me know what you think with this change in the comment section below.

Summary list : 
Adding skill effect (+7)
Adding sound effect when client spawn
Adding warning message 48h before taxes payement
Adding bank loan in marketing tab
SPACE now slowdown time instead of stop it
Fixed window overlapping on character creation
Reducing customer spawn frequency
Reducing taxes from 2000$ to 1800$
Ratio of blue mission up from 50% to 60%
